implementation_gaps.detail: Bootstrap from the pinned, verified Alpine v3.22 apk-tools-static 2.14.10-r0 artifact; package and empty-root validation remain required.
FPM 1.17.0 emitted an APK on r730-ai-01 and apk-tools 2.14.10 installed and registered it in an empty root on 2026-08-29; real payload adapters remain.
Generate and verify the AUZiX APKINDEX and signing-key contract.
Pinned apk.static successfully installed an FPM package into an empty root and reported it through apk info; exact base lock comparison remains.
auzix.activation.base wires package-owned base surfaces and emits an activation receipt; lab boot validation remains required.
Reuse the known kernel, initramfs and BIOS GRUB writer without granting it package mutation authority.
LibgccS1 is now a first-class package definition bound to the locked 2026-08-28 targeted repair producer; APK emission and installation remain gated.
Implement the target gates as executable validators and structured receipts.

promotion_boundary: Do not power or deploy to a VM until package emission, index verification, empty-root installation, activation and offline HDD validation all pass.
